dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product has pages that sit inside other pages, three or more levels deep, and shows on each the way back up: the levels above as links, in order, and the page itself last. On a narrow window it folds the middle levels behind one button.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a breadcrumb trail reads: the text style of its levels, the underline of a level that is a link, the corners of the shape that carries hover, focus and press, the gap between a glyph and its label, the glyph size, the separator's size, color and the space on either side of it, the gap between lines when the trail wraps, the color of a level that has no page, the timing of a state change, and for each pressable part (a level that is a link, the current page, the overflow button) its fill, content and state-layer colors at rest and in each state.
rules: A level with a destination is a link, underlined as underline.visibility names: it follows sys.behavior.link-underline, always in the default system. A level without one is text.

underline.visibility follows the system: set the sys token to change every text link at once, comp.breadcrumbs.underline.visibility to set the trail apart, and the underline prop to set one trail apart. Where it is not always, the link color must stand 3:1 apart from label.color, the color of a level that is text; the build checks it.
The current page is the last level. Give it no destination: it is then text, heavier than the links and not underlined. Do not color it as a link.
Separators are decorative glyphs drawn by the component and mirror in a right-to-left layout. Never write a separator into a label.
The trail collapses its middle by the width it is given; do not hide levels by hand.
State tokens are valued by the design system's pattern rules; override one token or replace the rule.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never style the anchors by hand.

shape.$description: The corners of the shape that carries hover, focus and press behind a level that is a link and behind the overflow button, and of the focus ring around it.

gap.$description: Space between a level's glyph and its label.

typescale.$description: The text style of every level.

color.$description: A level above the current page that has no destination: secondary text, not a link.

width.$description: The thickness of the underline of a level that is a link. The underline takes the label's color in every state.

offset.$description: How far below the text's baseline the underline is drawn.

visibility.$description: When the underline of a level that is a link is drawn. always: at rest and in every state. hover: while the level is hovered, focused from the keyboard or pressed, and not at rest. never: in no state. Follows the system's choice; a trail's underline prop overrides it (BRC-30). Forced colors draw it under every choice (BRC-24). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product draws its text links in one manner, and the system-wide choice gives it; the trail must be able to leave it, because a row of levels parted by separators is a set of navigation and not a sentence: a product may underline the links of its sentences and leave its trail clean, where position already says what a level is.

size.$description: The box of a level's glyph and of the overflow button's glyph.

gap.$description: Space between a separator and the level on either side of it.

color.$description: The separator between two levels. Decorative.

row-gap.$description: Space between two lines of a trail that wraps.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A level has no fill at rest; the surface behind its text shows through.

color.$description: The fill behind a level that is a link. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn.
The label, the underline and the glyph of a level that is a link: the role the vocabulary keeps for text links.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the container.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The current page has no fill at rest.

color.$description: The current page: the color of the text around it, because it is where the person is and not somewhere to go.
Used only where the product gives the current page a destination, so that it is a link.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The overflow button draws no fill at rest; its states draw the state layer.

color.$description: The glyph of the button that stands for the collapsed levels: a glyph alone is a step quieter than a word.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple: the pressed layer grows from the point of contact over this time, with state-easing. Unused by the other choices.
